Lines 360–361 show `create`, `update` as the capabilities for `push-app-credentials` and `push-ceph-keys`, but both HCL files now include `read` as well (added to support ESO's PushSecret reconciliation loop). The note immediately below the table (line 369) correctly mentions the `read` capability, but the table itself contradicts it. A reader scanning the table will find incorrect information.

| `push-ceph-keys` | `kv-v2/data/ceph/*` | `create`, `update`, `read` | PushSecret for Ceph client keys |
```
